name: Lucky Caravan
body:
Your caravan is blessed with good luck.

Prerequisite: Fortune-teller’s wagon.

Benefit: Once per week, you may roll twice when you are called upon to make an Attack, Security, or Resolve check. Take the higher result of these two rolls as your actual roll for the check.

Special: If your caravan loses its fortune-teller’s wagon, you lose the benefits of this feat until the fortune-teller’s wagon is repaired or replaced.
